summary: Implemented the endpoint resolution v2 builtin-parameter glue. In botocore/args.py, added ClientArgsCreator.compute_endpoint_resolver_builtin_defaults(), which returns a dict of builtin values (AWS::Region, AWS::UseFIPS, AWS::UseDualStack, SDK::Endpoint, the S3 and S3Control ARN/global/accelerate/path-style flags, and AWS::STS::UseGlobalEndpoint). compute_client_args now includes it under 'endpoint_resolver_builtins'. Added 11 unit tests in tests/unit/test_args.py (class TestEndpointResolverBuiltins). tests/unit/test_args.py and tests/unit/test_client.py pass (300 tests). The full unit suite has 11 failures, identical to the unmodified baseline, so none are caused by this change. Nothing was committed; the shared venv was not modified. ClientCreator and get_client_args are unchanged, so the builtins are computed but not consumed yet.
